about: PCA J110 step 1: the settings of today's MSA. Building 'msa' from the source gives back the source byte for byte (tools/apps/apps-build-check.mjs). Every other app's settings are read against these: a value here is what the source holds today, and the build stops if the source no longer says it.

manifest.data: PCF MSA J120 O1: the manifest is the file app/manifest.webmanifest itself, and tools/offline/install-links.mjs puts installHead on these pages (it checks the list is every app/*.html reader page). The one-source build takes MSA's installHead out of every other app's pages.

installHead: <link rel="manifest" href="./manifest.webmanifest" /><link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="./img/icons/msa-192.png" /><meta name="theme-color" content="#1B2A41" />
